en.intro: I’m Jianwei Jiao (焦建维), a 2024-cohort undergraduate in Computer Science and Technology (Elite Class) at Northwestern Polytechnical University’s School of Computer Science.
en.intro2: My interests lie in multimodal understanding and vision-language models, with a current focus on open-vocabulary segmentation and test-time adaptation.
en.degree: School of Computer Science · Computer Science and Technology (Elite Class) · Undergraduate
en.projectsDeck: Software, creative work and hands-on teamwork.
en.courtBody: Basketball is also part of my university life — through officiating, association work and supporting campus competitions.
en.serviceDeck: Contributing to the communities I’m part of.
en.volunteerBody: Campus activities, community initiatives and social practice.
en.intro3: I’m passionate about exploring the frontiers of AI and believe in AGI. Beyond research, I enjoy software development and take part in basketball officiating, student organizations and volunteer service.
en.contactBody: I welcome conversations about multimodal understanding and vision-language models, and I’m interested in research collaborations and internship opportunities where I can learn and contribute.
en.contactBody2: I’m also happy to exchange ideas about AI projects, discuss methods and implementation, or explore something new together. If our interests overlap, feel free to get in touch by email or connect with me on GitHub.
en.introRobotics: I also work on robotics research. Our team won two championships, one runner-up title and one third-place finish at RoboCup China 2026.

zh.intro: 我是焦建维，西北工业大学计算机学院 2024 级计算机科学与技术拔尖班本科生。
zh.intro2: 关注多模态理解与视觉语言模型，目前主要探索开放词汇分割与测试时适应。
zh.degree: 计算机学院 · 计算机科学与技术拔尖班 · 本科
zh.projectsDeck: 软件开发、创意作品与团队实践。
zh.courtBody: 篮球也是我大学生活的一部分。我参与篮球裁判、协会工作，并为校园赛事提供支持。
zh.serviceDeck: 参与集体事务，为身边的同学与社区贡献力量。
zh.volunteerBody: 参与校园活动、社区服务与社会实践。
zh.intro3: 热衷于探索 AI 的可能边界，相信 AGI。科研之外，也喜欢软件开发，参与篮球裁判、学生工作与志愿服务。
zh.contactBody: 欢迎与我交流多模态理解与视觉语言模型，也期待能够深入学习、参与实践的科研合作与实习机会。
zh.contactBody2: 我也很愿意交流 AI 项目的想法、方法与实现，和有共同兴趣的伙伴一起探索新问题。如果你感兴趣，欢迎通过邮件联系我，或在 GitHub 上交流。
zh.introRobotics: 我也从事机器人研究，所在团队在 2026 RoboCup 中国赛获双冠军、一亚军、一季军。
